column3: “Hair” makes the object of dividing explicit.
“Withdraw My favor” specifies the verb for diminishing; “idols” specifies detestable things.
“Or” replaces the conjunction between plague and famine; “outside your walls” specifies around you.
“Raging fury” does not retain the term for rebukes.
The change from “them” to “you” is leveled; the staff of bread becomes the supply of food.
